candidates.title: Interactive Companion Preview Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the companion selection view into an interactive preview stage where users can see pet animations and desktop behaviors live before adopting.
candidates.why: Adoption redesigns have shown consistent positive lifts (+1.7% average), and adoption currently takes a long median time of 89s / mean 1017s.

pick_friend.headline: Preview Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: See how your pet moves and interacts on your desktop before welcoming them home.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick a friend view into an interactive stage maintains the step's core job within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns have a proven +1.7% lift, but interactive preview stage requires high dev effort.

candidates.title: Account Pet Recovery & Persistence Assurance Copy
candidates.change: Update the sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in preserves saved pets and prevents profile resets.
candidates.why: The top support complaint (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in copy changes have a proven record of winning tests.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pets
sign_in.body: Your account keeps your custom desktop companions safe across sessions and prevents profile resets.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to emphasize pet persistence is an allowed copy change within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Targeting top complaint (8 emails) with proven sign_in copy changes (+1.7% lift) via simple copy config.

candidates.title: Carousel Path Selection Overview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign path selection into a carousel view comparing instant starter companions with custom photo-generated pets.
candidates.why: Choose_path redesign changes have shown positive results (+1.9% lift), and choose_path has a mean duration of 514s.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Creation Path
choose_path.body: Browse instant pre-made pets or create a custom pet from your own photos.

guard.reason: Carousel layout redesign for path selection retains both options (adopting and custom creation) and complies with onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesign shows positive historical lift (+1.9%), though carousel requires release work.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Live Progress Status Info
candidates.change: Display detailed progress indicators and estimated loading time on the waiting screen while initializing the desktop engine.
candidates.why: Home wait_info changes consistently win (+1.9% lift), addressing the long home step (median 201s / mean 2336s).

waiting.hint: Setting up desktop display overlays and pet physics engine...

guard.reason: Adding detailed progress and estimated wait time during engine initialization reflects a real wait and complies with fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info consistently yields +1.9% lift, addressing the step with longest wait times.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Quality Diagnostic Verification Flow
candidates.change: Add an instant preview checklist and retry option during photo upload to catch bad generation before final adoption.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted pet visual results during onboarding.

components.text: Photo lighting and clarity check complete

guard.reason: Adding diagnostic checklist components and preview/adjust actions to photo upload enhances the existing step without breaking rules.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 3 custom pet support tickets, but adding verification flows carries dev cost and uncertain baseline.

candidates.title: Multi-Account Pet Restoration Sign-In Hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint under sign-in buttons encouraging users to log into their original account to recover lost pets.
candidates.why: 8 users emailed support about missing pets after logging in with different credentials; sign_in hints directly address account confusion.

sign_in.hint: Logging in with your original account automatically restores your saved desktop pets.

guard.reason: Adding sign-in recovery hints is an acceptable onboarding copy update.

candidates.score_note: Directly resolves 8 user support emails regarding pet loss using high-confidence sign_in hint (+1.9% lift).

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Trait Customizer Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new `new_trait_customizer` screen before the adoption certificate to allow customizing companion traits and sound effects.
candidates.why: Adoption has the longest overall mean duration (1017s) and 3 support emails asked about controlling/talking to pets after setup.

new_trait_customizer.headline: Customize Pet Behavior
new_trait_customizer.body: Select your companion's sound effects, personality traits, and desktop movement style.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Render & Overlay Placement Status Info
candidates.change: Show detailed desktop overlay placement status and readiness notification options during launch initialization.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on the desktop; home wait_info tests have an established history of positive impact (+1.9%).

waiting.hint: Checking screen resolution and desktop window permissions...

guard.reason: Adding status hints and notifications during the waiting screen wait is permissible.

candidates.score_note: Combines proven home wait_info pattern (+1.9% lift) with targeting 3 desktop overlay support emails.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Clarity & Lighting Quality Hint
candidates.change: Provide guidance hints on the photo upload screen explaining photo quality requirements for accurate pet model generation.
candidates.why: Custom pet generation failures account for 3 support tickets, and adoption completion rate is a bottleneck.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload a well-lit photo showing your pet facing directly toward the camera.

guard.reason: Adding photo clarity guidance hints to photo upload complies with all onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Cheap config hint targeting 3 photo generation failure complaints during adoption step.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence Reorder
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pet adoption certificate creation so users pick and personalize their pet before creating an account.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 46.8%. Delaying account creation until emotional attachment is built increases completion motivation.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to after the adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Targets low overall conversion, but sequence reordering is costly and major flow changes historically perform poorly.
